messages:
Anya: sharing a short thread on the pool-affinity badges + guardrail confirmation microflow I mocked. goal: make it obvious which pools support burst & which will refuse increases beyond cap.
Maya: looks good. two quick asks: 1) change `Burst` label to `Temporary burst` everywhere, 2) add a tiny duration hint under the badge like `max 30m`.
Cole: agree on duration hint. also propose a small CPU/GPU family tag (e.g., A100/T4) on tiles so infra folks can pick by hardware.
Ben: backend note: some pools don't support burst at all. tile should show `Burst: not supported` and be disabled for that option. if user selects min above pool cap, show inline suggestion `Request quota increase` with a lightweight CTA not a modal.
Sam: a11y: ensure badges have aria-labels like `Burst supported: 30 minutes` and that the inline guardrail message is announced via aria-live polite. keyboard order must be pool -> min -> max -> burst -> save.
Anya: UX decision: when guardrail triggers do we block save or allow with confirm? leaning allow + confirm with a concise reason required for audit. thoughts?
Maya: allow + confirm is least disruptive. show a short sentence: "Min exceeds selected pool capacity; saving will schedule quota request." then two buttons: "Save anyway" and "Adjust to pool max." primary = Adjust for safety.
Ben: we'll emit an `override_quota` event with reason and user id. also add rate limits so we don't spam quota service.
Cole: visual nit: use amber outline + warning icon for guardrail instead of red; reserve red for hard errors.
Sam: color contrast check: amber text on white can fail at 12px. add an icon and bold the first sentence instead of relying on color alone.
design-bot: figma frames uploaded: https://www.figma.com/file/xyza1234/pool-affinity-badges - frames: "Tile-badges-v1", "Guardrail-inline-cta".
Anya: action items: I'll update copy to `Temporary burst` + duration hint, Maya will craft the two-line guardrail copy variants, Ben will confirm telemetry & rate limits, Sam will add aria snippets to the a11y checklist. reconvene after mocks are updated. :thumbsup:
